Emma / Markus — following up with the tables promised. Below are our baseline hosted API price bands (per 1K tokens) and the capacity credit mapping we recommend for Olive's profile: 

Baseline (no commit):
- Standard hosted model (high-quality float32): $0.018 per 1K tokens
- Quantized profile (8-bit): 25% reduction vs baseline
- Further aggressive quantization (4-bit) recommended for non-interactive batch: additional 20% off 8-bit rate

Proposed commit tiers (monthly token committed -> effective per-1K token):
- Tier A: 250M–499M tokens/month -> $0.012 per 1K (12-month), $0.011 (18-month)
- Tier B: 500M–1.99B tokens/month -> $0.009 per 1K (12-month), $0.008 per 1K (18-month)
- Tier C: >=2B tokens/month -> $0.006 per 1K (12-month), $0.005 per 1K (18-month)

Capacity credits mapping (simplified): 1 capacity credit = reserved sustained throughput equivalent to ~1.2M tokens/day (varies by session pattern). Example for Olive: 600M tokens/month ~= 20 credits/month. We recommend a 24-credit (monthly) commit with a 10% burst buffer for short peaks.

Overage / Burst behavior:
- Short bursts within burst buffer: free (no extra charge) up to 10% of committed credits/month, subject to fair-use
- Sustained overage above committed credits: billed at pay-as-you-go baseline band (with a pro-rated smoothing factor for that billing cycle)

I'll include the same table in the PDF; attaching for your review. Happy to walk through the math tomorrow.

Laura Bennett

Emma — short answers, then the blended math below.
1) Tier B $0.009/1K is an effective committed rate that assumes a negotiated mix — it is achievable without forcing all traffic to 8-bit, but the greatest margin (and lowest effective cost) assumes higher quantized usage.
2) Blended example for 600M tokens/month with 75% on 8-bit and 25% on float32: 
   - 8-bit effective per-1K (Tier B 12-month): 0.009 * 0.75 = 0.00675 contribution
   - float32 per-1K baseline: 0.018 * 0.25 = 0.0045 contribution
   - blended effective per-1K = 0.00675 + 0.0045 = $0.01125 per 1K tokens
   - Monthly cost estimate: (600,000 1K-token units) * $0.01125 = $6,750/month

3) Stepped commit option: we can structure a 12-month contract with a staged uplift clause — if you hit a pre-agreed usage breakpoint at month 6 (e.g., sustained 700M tokens/month for the trailing 30 days), the contract auto-upgrades to the 18-month pricing for the remaining term. We typically include a mutual-exit clause if growth targets aren't hit.

Ben — draft proposed SLA language for burst overage credits as previously discussed and I will include it in the redlines.

Laura
